title: Signed simultaneous derived tensor shift, second factor first
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. On $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] use the K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and its canonical coherent tensor shift structure [def-sc-scheme-canonical-tensor-shift]. For $M,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and arbitrary integers $a,b$, define $t_{a,b}:M[a]\otimes^{\mathbf L}N[b]\xrightarrow{\sim}(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}N)[a+b]$ by first extracting the second shift $b$, then applying the first-factor shift comparison for $a$ shifted by $b$, and finally combining the shifts by the inverse of the canonical $[a+b]\cong[a][b]$ comparison. Thus this is the specified second-shift-first Koszul comparison, with coefficient $(-1)^{bi}$ on a total K-flat model summand of shifted first-factor degree $i$, and no new tensor or shift structure is chosen.
